stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A company tested drone delivery in a small town.”?
options: A child asked why people should care about something far under the sea.
Every second Sunday, people in Pine Town bring broken things to the community center.
The drones carried medicine from a clinic to homes far from the center.
The old playground behind the community center had rusty swings and faded slides.
